snap_joints.release: Remove shell then press cartridge catch windows inward.

snap_joints.name: Service cap to crown
snap_joints.description: Two opposing tabs hook crown slots; removable cap is outside the hanging load path.
snap_joints.release: Press two crown windows inward, pull raised cross-grip.

snap_joints.name: Centered yoke to crown
snap_joints.description: Two 8 mm rectangular keys prevent pivot; outward barbs overlap socket walls by 1.05 mm.
snap_joints.release: After unloading hanger, press two outer socket windows inward and lift yoke. Cap services without yoke removal.

refill: Release two crown cap catches, lift cap 17 mm, then slide sideways through centered yoke opening. 28.7 mm fill throat; yoke stays attached. Remove shell and cartridge for complete wash access.
detail_features: Four external cantilever catches with through release windows
Printed 1.6 mm seed mesh with 2.4 mm radial walls
Integrated 2.6 mm through-drains
Independent refill hatch with two positive catches
Three swept structural rocket fins
Two staged hull bands and four recessed-look vertical ducts
Three recessed nose thermal courses and nine fin exhaust flutes; 0.7 mm skin relief
Rigid centered suspension yoke with two keyed positive snap sockets; unobstructed cap lift and sideways removal
assembly_method: Positive snap joints; one hanger suspends completed assembly

balance_check.note: Geometric balance estimate, not a hanging load rating or physical trial.
